info.description: Comprehensive API collection for AssistantHub REST API.

request.description: Accepts a full or partial AssistantHubSettings object. Supported sections: Webserver, Database, S3, DocumentAtom, Chunking, Inference, RecallDb, Logging.

request.description: Server-Sent Events stream for real-time eval run progress.
OpenAI-compatible chat completion. Thread ID is passed via the X-Thread-ID header. Response may include citations when EnableCitations is true in assistant settings.
Chat with metadata filter to restrict RAG retrieval to documents matching specified labels and/or tags.
OpenAI-compatible completion endpoint without RAG retrieval. Uses the assistant's configured completion endpoint.
